jobs.title: Senior Manager, Cloud Engineering & Infrastructure
jobs.description:
Senior Manager, Cloud Engineering & Infrastructure

Full-time | Onsite | Libertyville, IL | NO C2C

Summary

The Senior Manager, Cloud Engineering & Infrastructure will lead the strategy, modernization, reliability, and operational performance of a complex global hybrid infrastructure environment. This is a highly visible leadership role overseeing a globally distributed engineering organization that supports critical operations across manufacturing, R&D, commercial, and corporate functions.

This leader will play a key role in advancing cloud modernization, automation, and Infrastructure as Code while ensuring the reliability, resiliency, security, and performance of business-critical platforms. The successful candidate will bring the technical depth to lead experienced engineers, influence architecture and design decisions, and translate complex infrastructure priorities into clear business impact.

Key Responsibilities

Lead and develop a globally distributed Cloud & Infrastructure Engineering team, establishing engineering standards, operating models, performance expectations, documentation, and escalation processes.
Own the strategy, architecture alignment, lifecycle management, and modernization roadmap for the global hybrid infrastructure environment.
Provide leadership across Azure cloud infrastructure, VMware, Windows, enterprise storage and backup, data centers, Microsoft 365 dependencies, and related infrastructure platforms.
Drive cloud modernization through automation, Infrastructure as Code, configuration management, and repeatable deployment patterns.
Improve infrastructure reliability, scalability, and performance through SLAs/SLOs, KPI reporting, observability, capacity planning, performance management, and service readiness.
Own disaster recovery and infrastructure resiliency strategy, including backup and recovery, business continuity, RTO/RPO objectives, high availability, testing, runbooks, and remediation planning.
Lead major incident and problem management efforts, including triage, communication, root cause analysis, corrective actions, and post-incident learning.
Partner closely with Cybersecurity on infrastructure hardening, vulnerability management, access controls, secure operations, audit readiness, and recovery planning.
Collaborate with Enterprise Architecture, Networking, DevOps, application teams, NOC, Service Desk, project leadership, and business stakeholders to align infrastructure priorities with business needs.
Provide technical and strategic direction to senior engineers, challenge recommendations when appropriate, remove roadblocks, and improve team effectiveness and delivery.
Manage strategic technology vendors and partners, including performance, contracts, service delivery, and technology roadmaps.
Own infrastructure budgeting, forecasting, capacity planning, cloud cost optimization, and OpEx/CapEx considerations.
Communicate infrastructure health, risks, priorities, architectural trade-offs, and roadmaps to senior and executive leadership.
Support a global 24x7 operating environment and participate in major escalations and critical incident response as needed.
Stay current on evolving cloud and infrastructure technologies and identify opportunities to improve scalability, efficiency, reliability, and operational maturity.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and professional experience.
12+ years of progressive IT experience, including 8+ years supporting enterprise-scale hybrid infrastructure and cloud environments.
7+ years leading infrastructure engineering and/or operations teams with accountability for production services, performance, controls, metrics, and continuous improvement.
Demonstrated experience leading geographically distributed or global engineering teams and developing experienced technical professionals.
Strong technical foundation in enterprise infrastructure with the ability to credibly lead senior engineers and architects, challenge technical recommendations, and participate in architecture and design decisions.
Deep Microsoft Azure experience, including Azure infrastructure, Landing Zones, cloud governance, scalability, capacity planning, performance, and cost optimization.
Strong VMware and enterprise virtualization experience, including knowledge of the storage architecture supporting virtualized environments.
Strong Windows infrastructure experience within large enterprise environments.
Enterprise storage and backup expertise spanning cloud, virtualized, and on-premise environments.
Strong disaster recovery and resiliency experience, including backup and recovery, business continuity, high availability, RTO/RPO planning, testing, and remediation.
Experience with Microsoft 365 infrastructure and dependencies, including services such as Exchange Online, Teams, OneDrive, and SharePoint.
Experience driving automation and Infrastructure as Code using technologies such as Terraform, Bicep/ARM, PowerShell, configuration management, and source control.
Knowledge of Kubernetes and modern cloud engineering practices, including CI/CD alignment, automated deployment patterns, and cloud development environments.
Broad enterprise infrastructure knowledge encompassing data centers, networking integration, identity/RBAC, monitoring, connectivity, load balancing, and segmented environments.
Strong observability and reliability engineering experience, including monitoring/logging strategy, dashboards, capacity and performance management, and SLA/SLO/KPI-driven operations.
Proven mastery of ITIL-aligned incident, problem, and change management, including leadership during major incidents, root cause analysis, corrective actions, and post-incident improvement.
Demonstrated experience partnering with Cybersecurity on hardening, vulnerability management, access controls, secure operations, compliance, audit readiness, and infrastructure resiliency.
Experience managing enterprise technology vendors, budgets, forecasts, cloud/infrastructure costs, and OpEx/CapEx considerations.
Experience supporting business-critical infrastructure within a complex, global 24x7 enterprise environment.
Strong executive presence, stakeholder management, and business acumen with the ability to communicate technical risks, priorities, investment decisions, and trade-offs in terms of business impact.
Ability to operate as a strategic leader while maintaining the technical depth necessary to understand what engineering teams are building and make informed technology decisions.

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
jobs.description:
Chief Technology Officer

Foresio AI, LLC · Remote (United States) · Equity Compensation
About the company

Foresio AI is a B2B software platform serving independent restaurant operators. Our product is built around seven AI advisors (and counting), each responsible for a distinct area of restaurant operations, including accounting, inventory, staffing, reputation management, competitive research, menu performance, and daily reporting. The advisors deliver intelligence and execute actions across the channels operators already use.
The product is built and in the market. We have an engineering team covering backend, frontend, and quality assurance, a project manager, and a sales organization of more than 30 representatives running outbound. What the company needs now is a single technical leader who owns architecture, quality, and delivery.
The role

The Chief Technology Officer owns all technical decisions at Foresio and directly manages the existing engineering team. This is a leadership position, not an individual contributor role with a title attached. You will spend a significant portion of your time reviewing other people's work, setting the standard for what ships, and raising the level of the team already here.
Responsibilities

Own system architecture across the platform, the advisor layer, and all third-party integrations
Manage the current engineering team, including backend, frontend, and quality assurance, and set clear expectations, priorities, and deadlines for each person
Review code, technical designs, and completed work before it reaches production, and hold the team to a consistent quality bar
Run regular one-on-one meetings and provide direct performance feedback, including where someone is falling short
Establish and enforce engineering process, including code review standards, testing requirements, deployment procedures, and documentation
Determine the technical roadmap in partnership with the founder and translate business priorities into a sequenced engineering plan
Own the reliability, security, and performance of the platform
Make build versus buy decisions and manage infrastructure and vendor costs
Lead technical hiring as the team grows

Requirements

Substantial experience building and operating production software systems that paying customers depended on
Direct experience managing engineers, including reviewing their work, giving corrective feedback, and improving individual performance over time
Practical experience shipping products built on large language models beyond the prototype stage, with a working understanding of what fails in production
Demonstrated ability to move quickly without accumulating technical debt that stalls the company six months later
Comfort operating with incomplete information and making decisions without waiting for consensus
Willingness to accept equity as compensation, which requires a personal financial situation that supports it

Compensation

This position is compensated in equity with standard four-year vesting and a one-year cliff. There is no salary until the company completes a funding round, at which point compensation will be revisited. The equity grant is meaningful and reflects ownership by the founding team rather than a standard early-employee grant.
To apply

Send a summary of systems you have built and operated, a description of teams you have managed and how you handled a performance problem on one of them, and your assessment of what would concern you most about this opportunity to hello@foresioai.com. (Subject should be Chief Technology Officer Application)

new_jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
new_jobs.description:
Chief Technology Officer

Foresio AI, LLC · Remote (United States) · Equity Compensation
About the company

Foresio AI is a B2B software platform serving independent restaurant operators. Our product is built around seven AI advisors (and counting), each responsible for a distinct area of restaurant operations, including accounting, inventory, staffing, reputation management, competitive research, menu performance, and daily reporting. The advisors deliver intelligence and execute actions across the channels operators already use.
The product is built and in the market. We have an engineering team covering backend, frontend, and quality assurance, a project manager, and a sales organization of more than 30 representatives running outbound. What the company needs now is a single technical leader who owns architecture, quality, and delivery.
The role

The Chief Technology Officer owns all technical decisions at Foresio and directly manages the existing engineering team. This is a leadership position, not an individual contributor role with a title attached. You will spend a significant portion of your time reviewing other people's work, setting the standard for what ships, and raising the level of the team already here.
Responsibilities

Own system architecture across the platform, the advisor layer, and all third-party integrations
Manage the current engineering team, including backend, frontend, and quality assurance, and set clear expectations, priorities, and deadlines for each person
Review code, technical designs, and completed work before it reaches production, and hold the team to a consistent quality bar
Run regular one-on-one meetings and provide direct performance feedback, including where someone is falling short
Establish and enforce engineering process, including code review standards, testing requirements, deployment procedures, and documentation
Determine the technical roadmap in partnership with the founder and translate business priorities into a sequenced engineering plan
Own the reliability, security, and performance of the platform
Make build versus buy decisions and manage infrastructure and vendor costs
Lead technical hiring as the team grows

Requirements

Substantial experience building and operating production software systems that paying customers depended on
Direct experience managing engineers, including reviewing their work, giving corrective feedback, and improving individual performance over time
Practical experience shipping products built on large language models beyond the prototype stage, with a working understanding of what fails in production
Demonstrated ability to move quickly without accumulating technical debt that stalls the company six months later
Comfort operating with incomplete information and making decisions without waiting for consensus
Willingness to accept equity as compensation, which requires a personal financial situation that supports it

Compensation

This position is compensated in equity with standard four-year vesting and a one-year cliff. There is no salary until the company completes a funding round, at which point compensation will be revisited. The equity grant is meaningful and reflects ownership by the founding team rather than a standard early-employee grant.
To apply

Send a summary of systems you have built and operated, a description of teams you have managed and how you handled a performance problem on one of them, and your assessment of what would concern you most about this opportunity to hello@foresioai.com. (Subject should be Chief Technology Officer Application)
